warehouse management tools, and inventory barcoding configurations.

**Desirable Languages:** Kannada, Telugu and Tamil.

**Job Purpose**

The Manager Operations directs daily business activities across production, logistics, installation, transport, and R\&D, while enforcing rigorous quality control, 5S/Kaizen methodologies, and ISO compliance. This role ensures total workflow visibility—from raw materials to Work\-in\-Progress (WIP), Ready to Dispatch status, and scrap auditing—while maintaining strict adherence to standard corporate policies and SOPs.

**Key Responsibilities \& Core Functions :**

**1\. Production, WIP \& Workflow Management :**

· **Production Scheduling:** Direct daily manufacturing workflows to hit output targets and meet timeline deadlines.

· **Capacity Planning:** Analyze production constraints and scale labor and machinery to balance workload fluctuations.

· **Equipment Maintenance:** Implement and monitor predictive and preventive maintenance programs for facility machinery.

· **WIP Tracking:** Monitor Work\-in\-Progress (WIP) levels across production lines to identify bottlenecks and balance line capacity.

· **Cycle Time Reduction:** Optimize manufacturing cycle times and lead times through line\-balancing and layout efficiency.

· **SOP Adherence:** Audit assembly lines daily to ensure technicians strictly follow standard operating procedures (SOPs).

· Should be flexible to ready to relocate to any of the branches – PAN India.

· Adhering to the KRA \& KPI and acting on time to time basis upgrades and tasks as assigned by the reporting managers.

**2\. Research \& Development (R\&D) \& Prototypes :**

· **Cross\-Functional Design:** Collaborate with design engineers to bridge the gap between initial product conceptualization and volume production.

· **Prototype Testing:** Manage the dedicated pipeline for creating, assembling, and iterating early\-stage hardware prototypes.

· **DFM Validation:** Conduct Design for Manufacturing (DFM) reviews to ensure R\&D outputs can be scaled efficiently in production.

· **Material Testing:** Validate raw material alternatives for prototypes to optimize durability and cost\-efficiency.

· **IP Protection:** Enforce internal documentation standards to protect trade secrets and intellectual property during testing phases.

**3\. Logistics, Warehousing \& Transport :**

· **BIN Management:** Establish and audit systematic BIN location tracking within the ERP system to maintain 100% warehouse inventory accuracy.

· **Inbound Logistics:** Manage receiving hubs, freight forwarders, and customs clearance procedures for global materials.

· **Fleet Management:** Coordinate the internal or third\-party (3PL) transport fleet, optimizing routing and fuel efficiency.

· **Distribution Oversight:** Supervise the dispatching, staging, and packing teams to ensure damage\-free cargo preparation.

· **Transit Compliance:** Enforce Department of Transportation (DOT) and local shipping laws for all physical transport.

**4\. Ready to Dispatch (RTD) \& Finished Goods :**

· **RTD Verification:** Supervise the final staging area to verify that 'Ready to Dispatch' batches match shipping manifests perfectly.

· **Pre\-Shipment Inspections:** Execute final visual and functional packaging audits before cargo is loaded onto transit vehicles.

· **Documentation Controls:** Ensure all commercial invoices, packing lists, and certificates of conformance are attached to outgoing shipments.

**5\. Quality Assurance, Audits \& ISO Standards :**

· **ISO Compliance:** Maintain operational alignment with ISO standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 ) and coordinate external recertification audits.

· **Internal Audits:** Schedule and execute routine internal audits across production, warehousing, and installation processes.

· **Quality Gates:** Manage quality control (QC) gates at critical manufacturing intervals to capture and flag component defects early.

· **CAPA Management:** Lead Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) investigations when quality deviations or customer complaints occur.

**6\. 5S, Kaizen \& Continuous Improvement :**

· **5S Implementation:** Standardize and sustain 5S practices (Sort, Set in Order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain) across the shop floor and warehouse.

· **5S Auditing:** Conduct weekly 5S scoresheets and audits, publicizing results to drive accountability among team leaders.

· **Kaizen Events:** Lead cross\-functional Kaizen continuous improvement events to optimize workspaces, save time, and reduce waste.

· **Visual Management:** Deploy visual controls, floor markings, and shadow boards to maintain an organized, self\-explaining workspace.

**7\. Scrap Management \& Material Audits :**

· **Scrap Auditing:** Oversee the segregation, categorization, and weighing of production scrap and rejected materials.

· **Defect Material Tracking:** Document MRB (Material Review Board) actions, isolating non\-conforming materials from regular stock.

· **Waste Reduction Strategy:** Analyze scrap trends to identify root causes of material loss and execute remediation projects.

**8\. Installation \& Field Operations :**

· **Deployment Scheduling:** Coordinate field technician schedules for complex installations, retrofits, and testing at client sites.

· **Site Readiness:** Review site evaluation checklists and confirm engineering specifications before deploying field teams.

· **Safety Protocols:** Implement and enforce rigorous OSHA and safety guidelines on\-site during hazardous installations.

· **Client Handover:** Manage post\-installation inspections and secure signed sign\-off documentation from clients.

· **Subcontractor Management:** Vet, onboard, and manage external contractors hired for specialized regional installations.

**9\. Reporting \& Governance :**
